notes.content: An unsigned typed letter page, addressed to Grothendieck from Voorschoten and dated May 16 1967, with blue handwritten corrections and mathematical characters. Paragraph 1 asks whether the construction can be understood through the behavior of a covering over the s(M). Paragraph 2 questions uniqueness of extra structure for Galois coverings, commuting group actions, and a claimed full-faithfulness result. Paragraph 3 asks about example 3a and proposes a divisibility-shaped condition in place of a componentwise-looking inequality. These covering-theory claims are carried as the letter’s unverified questions, not proved here. All text, formula occurrences, corrections, and margins were read from the three authorized source views. Eleven local crops were created and viewed once each. Crop 07 reaches the lower edge of the small Hom subscript; the complete curve was visible in half b, and its case remains unresolved. S.json contains no rows.
